### Refused
- U23 n ir sp snnw read as the ordinal "second", not sp sn "(Twice.)": the signs are two strokes over the pot nw, the ordinal ending; sp sn in every published part is O50 + Z4/Z4A with no nw, and the same group is read snnw in Spell 18's introduction, Spell 147 and the Weighing ("a second time(?)"). Kept; Budge's 'second' agrees.
- "The papyrus writes X; read Y" cases kept: U19 ḫ-n → nḫn (the town classifier and Budge's Neχen leave one reading); U35 mꜣꜣ·s with strokes → mꜣꜣ·sn (Budge's own brackets; 015-a codes the full ·sn the same way); U44 sun-disk before the genitive n (no word takes it; Budge reads en). Each note opens with the formula.
- U0 ḫr-ꜥḥꜣ for Budge's χer-āba: the town sign and ḫr fit the district by Heliopolis named in the published Spell 125 (ḫr-ꜥḥꜣ), and Heliopolis is named in the same strophe; doubt stated, l/i carry (?). Kept (honesty sentence added, see changes).
- U43 dgꜣ with X4/Q7: codes are the established reader's and cannot change; roles phon d / phon g kept with the doubt now stated in full (see changes).
- U21 idbwy: N9 log with three classifiers cannot spell the word; the note says no sign spells the sounds, follows Budge's àṭeb and calls it doubtful; same standing as 015-a's itrty. Kept.
- U31 ḥtp·ṯi: stative with ·ṯi said of Ani; the note gives both explanations (later 3rd masc. use, or a slip). Kept (gloss hedged only).
- U0 imyt (U1 w13): feminine nisba where imyw is expected; note gives imytw as the alternative (as in 015-a), l/i carry (?). Kept.
- Joins/splits: ind | ḥr·k (U0–U21, Budge's spacing, as 015-a) and ind | ḥr·k from Budge's one group in U32 (as in the litany); di·k | n·i (U22) and wḏ | n·i (U46, ntk is + participle needs wḏ as a participle, not wḏ·n·i); ḥꜥ | n (U24, both readings stated); in joined with its n (U17, house spelling W25 + N35). All stated in the notes. Kept.
- U30 wḏꜣ·f with V24 (wḏ) and no ꜣ: same wish as 015-a's wḏꜣ·k; doubt stated, Budge's utu-f given. Kept.
- U30 mꜥnḏt "Mandjet-bark" against 015-a's ꜥḏt "Adjet-bark": the signs here have m + ꜥ before V26, and the known ꜥḏt gloss itself names mꜥnḏt as the usual name; new lemma justified. Kept.
- U15 ḫnm n ḥꜥw·k tꜣ-ḏsr with tꜣ-ḏsr as subject: the n stands before ḥꜥw·k, so Budge's 'thy limbs are joined to the netherworld' does not fit the order; the doubt is stated, l/i carry (?). Kept.
- U42 E23 coded phon rw (not read) in šnꜥ·tw: matches Spell 1 (001-b), to which the note points; the hymn to Osiris codes it det. Kept.
- U8 mkt·f and U28 mšrw with the G17+D36 ligature's arm as det: mkt is so coded in Spells 44 and 147; kept for both.
- U25 i before Wsir ꜣny: kept as written ('O'), with the drafter's note that it may be anticipation; Budge also reads à.
- U44 l "because" over ḥr ntt: Budge's pairing, the note explains both words. Kept.
- U26 "lord of rays", U20 "maker of the gods", U45 "the land of eternity": coincide with Budge only because they are the literal words; no better English. Kept.
